# Data Source: identitynow_identity_profile

Use this data source to look up an identity profile by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_identity_profile" "employees" {
  name = "Employees"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identity profile ID. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Identity profile name. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `attribute_config_json` (String) Identity attribute mappings as a JSON array.
- `authoritative_source` (Attributes List) Authoritative source of the identity profile, a list with one element with `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authoritative_source))
- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Description of the identity profile.
- `has_time_based_attr` (Boolean) Whether the profile has time based attributes.
- `identity_attribute_config_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the identity attribute mappings are enabled.
- `identity_count` (Number) Number of identities belonging to the profile.
- `identity_exception_report_name` (String) Name of the last identity exception report.
- `identity_exception_report_task_result_id` (String) Task result ID of the last identity exception report.
- `identity_refresh_required` (Boolean) Whether an identity refresh is required for the profile.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `owner` (Attributes List) Owner of the identity profile, a list with one element with `id`, `type` and `name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the identity profile.

<a id="nestedatt--authoritative_source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authoritative_source`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Object ID.
- `name` (String) Object name.
- `type` (String) Object type.
